model.pfas_warehouse.mart_county_scoreca.raw_code:
-- Mart model: North Carolina County-level PFAS Screening Scorecard.
-- Compares EPA UCMR 5 occurrence results against 2024 EPA MCL & Hazard Index benchmarks
-- strictly for informational occurrence screening.

WITH screened AS (
    SELECT * FROM {{ ref('int_ucmr5_pfas_screened') }}
),

systems AS (
    SELECT * FROM {{ ref('mart_system_screening') }}
),

county_sample_agg AS (
    SELECT
        county_name,
        COUNT(*) AS total_samples,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analyte_group = 'PFAS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pfas_samples,
        SUM(CASE WHEN is_detected THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS detected_samples,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analyte_group = 'PFAS' AND is_detected THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pfas_detected_samples,
        SUM(CASE WHEN has_mcl_benchmark_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mcl_screened_samples,
        SUM(CASE WHEN above_mcl_benchmark_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS samples_above_mcl_benchmark,
        MAX(benchmark_ratio) AS max_benchmark_ratio,
        MAX(CASE WHEN analyte_group = 'PFAS' AND is_detected THEN result_ppt END) AS max_detected_pfas_ppt
    FROM screened
    GROUP BY county_name
),

county_system_agg AS (
    SELECT
        county_name,
        COUNT(*) AS systems_monitored,
        SUM(CASE WHEN above_any_mcl_benchmark_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS systems_above_mcl_benchmark,
        SUM(CASE WHEN above_hi_benchmark_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS systems_above_hi_benchmark,
        SUM(CASE WHEN above_any_mcl_benchmark_flag OR above_hi_benchmark_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            AS systems_above_any_2024_benchmark,
        MAX(max_hazard_index_score) AS max_hazard_index_score
    FROM systems
    GROUP BY county_name
),

primary_analyte AS (
    SELECT
        county_name,
        contaminant AS primary_exceeding_analyte,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY county_name
            ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MAX(benchmark_ratio) DESC, contaminant ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM screened
    WHERE above_mcl_benchmark_flag = TRUE
    GROUP BY county_name, contaminant
)

SELECT
    c.county_name,
    sy.systems_monitored,
    c.total_samples,
    c.pfas_samples,
    c.detected_samples,
    c.pfas_detected_samples,
    ROUND(100.0 * c.detected_samples / NULLIF(c.total_samples, 0), 2) AS detection_rate_pct,
    ROUND(100.0 * c.pfas_detected_samples / NULLIF(c.pfas_samples, 0), 2) AS pfas_detection_rate_pct,
    c.mcl_screened_samples,
    c.samples_above_mcl_benchmark,
    ROUND(100.0 * c.samples_above_mcl_benchmark / NULLIF(c.mcl_screened_samples, 0), 2)
        AS mcl_benchmark_exceedance_rate_pct,
    sy.systems_above_mcl_benchmark,
    sy.systems_above_hi_benchmark,
    sy.systems_above_any_2024_benchmark,
    ROUND(100.0 * sy.systems_above_any_2024_benchmark / NULLIF(sy.systems_monitored, 0), 2)
        AS share_systems_above_benchmark_pct,
    ROUND(c.max_benchmark_ratio, 3) AS max_benchmark_ratio,
    ROUND(c.max_detected_pfas_ppt, 3) AS max_detected_pfas_ppt,
    ROUND(COALESCE(sy.max_hazard_index_score, 0.0), 4) AS max_hazard_index_score,
    COALESCE(pa.primary_exceeding_analyte, 'None') AS primary_exceeding_analyte,
    CASE
        WHEN sy.systems_above_any_2024_benchmark > 0 THEN 'Above 2024 Screening Benchmark Observed'
        WHEN c.pfas_detected_samples > 0 THEN 'PFAS Detected Below 2024 Screening Benchmarks'
        ELSE 'No PFAS Detections (>= MRL)'
    END AS screening_summary_label
FROM county_sample_agg c
INNER JOIN county_system_agg sy
    ON c.county_name = sy.county_name
LEFT JOIN primary_analyte pa
    ON c.county_name = pa.county_name
    AND pa.rn = 1
ORDER BY
    c.samples_above_mcl_benchmark DESC,
    sy.systems_above_any_2024_benchmark DESC,
    c.pfas_detected_samples DESC,
    c.county_name ASC

model.pfas_warehouse.mart_analyte_summar.name: mart_analyte_summary
model.pfas_warehouse.mart_analyte_summar.description: Per-analyte EPA UCMR 5 occurrence and 2024 MCL screening summary across all monitored NC contaminants (29 PFAS + lithium).

contaminant.name: contaminant
contaminant.description: Primary key: EPA UCMR 5 analyte name.

total_samples.name: total_samples
total_samples.description: Total NC analytical results for this analyte.

model.pfas_warehouse.mart_analyte_summar.raw_code:
-- Mart model: Per-analyte UCMR 5 occurrence and 2024 MCL screening summary (29 PFAS + lithium).

WITH screened AS (
    SELECT * FROM {{ ref('int_ucmr5_pfas_screened') }}
)

SELECT
    contaminant,
    MIN(analyte_group) AS analyte_group,
    MAX(mcl_benchmark_ppt) AS mcl_benchmark_ppt,
    MAX(hbwc_ppt) AS hbwc_ppt,
    BOOL_OR(in_hazard_index) AS in_hazard_index,
    COUNT(*) AS total_samples,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pwsid) AS systems_tested,
    COUNT(DISTINCT county_name) AS counties_tested,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_detected THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS detected_samples,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_detected THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2)
        AS detection_rate_pct,
    ROUND(
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY result_ppt)
            FILTER (WHERE is_detected AND result_ppt IS NOT NULL),
        3
    ) AS p50_detected_ppt,
    ROUND(
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.90) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY result_ppt)
            FILTER (WHERE is_detected AND result_ppt IS NOT NULL),
        3
    ) AS p90_detected_ppt,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN is_detected THEN result_ppt END), 3) AS max_detected_ppt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN above_mcl_benchmark_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS samples_above_mcl_benchmark,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN above_mcl_benchmark_flag THEN pwsid END) AS systems_above_mcl_benchmark,
    ROUND(MAX(benchmark_ratio), 3) AS max_benchmark_ratio
FROM screened
GROUP BY contaminant
ORDER BY
    samples_above_mcl_benchmark DESC,
    detected_samples DESC,
    contaminant ASC

model.pfas_warehouse.mart_system_screeni.name: mart_system_screening
model.pfas_warehouse.mart_system_screeni.description: Water-system-level (PWSID) occurrence summary vs all six 2024 EPA PFAS MCL and Hazard Index screening benchmarks. Screening language strictly enforced.

pwsid.name: pwsid
pwsid.description: Primary key: NC Public Water System Identifier.

model.pfas_warehouse.mart_system_screeni.raw_code:
-- Mart model: NC Water System-level PFAS screening scorecard vs 2024 EPA benchmarks.
-- Screening-only language enforced across all columns and status labels.

WITH screened AS (
    SELECT * FROM {{ ref('int_ucmr5_pfas_screened') }}
),

hi_by_system AS (
    SELECT
        pwsid,
        MAX(hazard_index_score) AS max_hazard_index_score,
        BOOL_OR(above_hi_benchmark_flag) AS above_hi_benchmark_flag,
        SUM(CASE WHEN above_hi_benchmark_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS events_above_hi_benchmark
    FROM {{ ref('int_system_hazard_index') }}
    GROUP BY pwsid
),

system_agg AS (
    SELECT
        pwsid,
        MIN(pws_name) AS pws_name,
        MIN(county_name) AS county_name,
        MIN(size_code) AS size_code,
        MIN(size_category) AS size_category,
        MIN(collection_date) AS first_collection_date,
        MAX(collection_date) AS last_collection_date,
        COUNT(*) AS total_samples,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analyte_group = 'PFAS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pfas_samples,
        SUM(CASE WHEN is_detected THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS detected_samples,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analyte_group = 'PFAS' AND is_detected THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pfas_detected_samples,
        SUM(CASE WHEN has_mcl_benchmark_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mcl_screened_samples,
        SUM(CASE WHEN above_mcl_benchmark_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS samples_above_mcl_benchmark,
        MAX(CASE WHEN contaminant = 'PFOA' AND is_detected THEN result_ppt END) AS max_pfoa_ppt,
        MAX(CASE WHEN contaminant = 'PFOS' AND is_detected THEN result_ppt END) AS max_pfos_ppt,
        MAX(CASE WHEN contaminant = 'PFHxS' AND is_detected THEN result_ppt END) AS max_pfhxs_ppt,
        MAX(CASE WHEN contaminant = 'PFNA' AND is_detected THEN result_ppt END) AS max_pfna_ppt,
        MAX(CASE WHEN contaminant = 'HFPO-DA' AND is_detected THEN result_ppt END) AS max_hfpo_da_ppt,
        MAX(CASE WHEN contaminant = 'PFBS' AND is_detected THEN result_ppt END) AS max_pfbs_ppt,
        AVG(CASE WHEN analyte_group = 'PFAS' AND is_detected THEN result_ppt END) AS mean_detected_pfas_ppt,
        MAX(CASE WHEN analyte_group = 'PFAS' AND is_detected THEN result_ppt END) AS max_detected_pfas_ppt,
        MAX(benchmark_ratio) AS max_benchmark_ratio
    FROM screened
    GROUP BY pwsid
)

SELECT
    s.pwsid,
    s.pws_name,
    s.county_name,
    s.size_code,
    s.size_category,
    s.first_collection_date,
    s.last_collection_date,
    s.total_samples,
    s.pfas_samples,
    s.detected_samples,
    s.pfas_detected_samples,
    ROUND(100.0 * s.detected_samples / NULLIF(s.total_samples, 0), 2) AS detection_rate_pct,
    ROUND(100.0 * s.pfas_detected_samples / NULLIF(s.pfas_samples, 0), 2) AS pfas_detection_rate_pct,
    s.mcl_screened_samples,
    s.samples_above_mcl_benchmark,
    (s.samples_above_mcl_benchmark > 0) AS above_any_mcl_benchmark_flag,
    ROUND(s.max_pfoa_ppt, 3) AS max_pfoa_ppt,
    ROUND(s.max_pfos_ppt, 3) AS max_pfos_ppt,
    ROUND(s.max_pfhxs_ppt, 3) AS max_pfhxs_ppt,
    ROUND(s.max_pfna_ppt, 3) AS max_pfna_ppt,
    ROUND(s.max_hfpo_da_ppt, 3) AS max_hfpo_da_ppt,
    ROUND(s.max_pfbs_ppt, 3) AS max_pfbs_ppt,
    ROUND(s.mean_detected_pfas_ppt, 3) AS mean_detected_pfas_ppt,
    ROUND(s.max_detected_pfas_ppt, 3) AS max_detected_pfas_ppt,
    ROUND(s.max_benchmark_ratio, 3) AS max_benchmark_ratio,
    ROUND(COALESCE(h.max_hazard_index_score, 0.0), 4) AS max_hazard_index_score,
    COALESCE(h.above_hi_benchmark_flag, FALSE) AS above_hi_benchmark_flag,
    COALESCE(h.events_above_hi_benchmark, 0) AS events_above_hi_benchmark,
    CASE
        WHEN s.samples_above_mcl_benchmark > 0 AND COALESCE(h.above_hi_benchmark_flag, FALSE)
            THEN 'Above Individual MCL & Hazard Index Screening Benchmarks'
        WHEN s.samples_above_mcl_benchmark > 0
            THEN 'Above 2024 Individual MCL Screening Benchmark'
        WHEN COALESCE(h.above_hi_benchmark_flag, FALSE)
            THEN 'Above 2024 Hazard Index Screening Benchmark (>1.0)'
        WHEN s.pfas_detected_samples > 0
            THEN 'PFAS Detected Below 2024 Screening Benchmarks'
        WHEN s.detected_samples > 0
            THEN 'Non-PFAS Analyte Detected Only'
        ELSE 'No Detections (>= MRL)'
    END AS screening_status
FROM system_agg s
LEFT JOIN hi_by_system h
    ON s.pwsid = h.pwsid
ORDER BY
    s.samples_above_mcl_benchmark DESC,
    s.max_benchmark_ratio DESC NULLS LAST,
    s.pwsid ASC

model.pfas_warehouse.stg_ucmr5_results.name: stg_ucmr5_results
model.pfas_warehouse.stg_ucmr5_results.description: Typed North Carolina EPA UCMR 5 analytical occurrence results with standardized concentrations in both ug/L and ppt (ng/L). Screening data only.

result_row_id.name: result_row_id
result_row_id.description: Deterministic surrogate primary key from raw ingest row sequence.

contaminant.name: contaminant
contaminant.description: EPA UCMR 5 analyte name (29 PFAS or lithium).

analytical_results_sign.name: analytical_results_sign
analytical_results_sign.description: EPA detection qualifier ('<' below MRL, '=' quantified detection).

model.pfas_warehouse.stg_ucmr5_results.raw_code:
-- Staging model: cleaned, typed EPA UCMR 5 North Carolina analytical results.
-- Framing: occurrence/screening data only (100% public-domain U.S. EPA dataset).

WITH src AS (
    SELECT * FROM {{ source('raw_ucmr5', 'ucmr5_nc_results') }}
),

typed AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(row_num AS BIGINT) AS result_row_id,
        TRIM(pwsid) AS pwsid,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(pws_name), ''), 'UNKNOWN_SYSTEM') AS pws_name,
        UPPER(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(size_code), ''), 'U')) AS size_code,
        CASE UPPER(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(size_code), ''), 'U'))
            WHEN 'L' THEN 'Large (>10,000)'
            WHEN 'S' THEN 'Small (<=10,000)'
            ELSE 'Unknown'
        END AS size_category,
        NULLIF(TRIM(facility_id), '') AS facility_id,
        NULLIF(TRIM(facility_name), '') AS facility_name,
        NULLIF(TRIM(facility_water_type), '') AS facility_water_type,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(sample_point_id), ''), 'UNKNOWN_SP') AS sample_point_id,
        NULLIF(TRIM(sample_point_name), '') AS sample_point_name,
        NULLIF(TRIM(sample_point_type), '') AS sample_point_type,
        COALESCE(
            CAST(TRY_STRPTIME(TRIM(collection_date_raw), '%m/%d/%Y') AS DATE),
            TRY_CAST(TRIM(collection_date_raw) AS DATE)
        ) AS collection_date,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(sample_id), ''), 'UNKNOWN_SAMPLE') AS sample_id,
        TRIM(contaminant) AS contaminant,
        CASE
            WHEN LOWER(TRIM(contaminant)) = 'lithium' THEN 'Lithium'
            ELSE 'PFAS'
        END AS analyte_group,
        TRY_CAST(mrl_raw AS DOUBLE) AS mrl_ug_l,
        CASE
            WHEN TRY_CAST(mrl_raw AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL
            THEN TRY_CAST(mrl_raw AS DOUBLE) * 1000.0
            ELSE NULL
        END AS mrl_ppt,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(units), ''), 'ug/L') AS units,
        NULLIF(TRIM(method_id), '') AS method_id,
        TRIM(analytical_results_sign) AS analytical_results_sign,
        (TRIM(analytical_results_sign) = '=') AS is_detected,
        CASE
            WHEN TRIM(analytical_results_sign) = '='
            THEN TRY_CAST(analytical_result_value_raw AS DOUBLE)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS result_ug_l,
        CASE
            WHEN TRIM(analytical_results_sign) = '='
                 AND TRY_CAST(analytical_result_value_raw AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL
            THEN TRY_CAST(analytical_result_value_raw AS DOUBLE) * 1000.0
            ELSE NULL
        END AS result_ppt,
        NULLIF(TRIM(sample_event_code), '') AS sample_event_code,
        NULLIF(TRIM(monitoring_requirement), '') AS monitoring_requirement,
        NULLIF(TRIM(epa_region), '') AS epa_region,
        UPPER(TRIM(state_code)) AS state_code
    FROM src
)

SELECT
    result_row_id,
    pwsid,
    pws_name,
    size_code,
    size_category,
    facility_id,
    facility_name,
    facility_water_type,
    sample_point_id,
    sample_point_name,
    sample_point_type,
    collection_date,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM collection_date)::INTEGER AS collection_year,
    EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM collection_date)::INTEGER AS collection_quarter,
    CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM collection_date) AS VARCHAR)
        || '-Q'
        || CAST(EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM collection_date) AS VARCHAR) AS year_quarter,
    sample_id,
    contaminant,
    analyte_group,
    mrl_ug_l,
    mrl_ppt,
    units,
    method_id,
    analytical_results_sign,
    is_detected,
    result_ug_l,
    result_ppt,
    sample_event_code,
    monitoring_requirement,
    epa_region,
    state_code
FROM typed

model.pfas_warehouse.stg_pws_county_cros.name: stg_pws_county_crosswalk
model.pfas_warehouse.stg_pws_county_cros.description: One row per NC Public Water System observed in UCMR 5, joined to EPA SDWIS county geography with explicit 'UNMAPPED_COUNTY' fallback for any unmapped PWSID.

pwsid.name: pwsid
pwsid.description: Primary key: NC Public Water System Identifier.

county_name.name: county_name
county_name.description: NC county served from EPA SDWIS, or 'UNMAPPED_COUNTY'.

model.pfas_warehouse.stg_pws_county_cros.raw_code:
-- Staging model: deduplicated NC PWSID-to-County crosswalk.
-- Any NC water system without an EPA SDWIS county match is explicitly labelled
-- 'UNMAPPED_COUNTY' so zero UCMR 5 occurrence records are ever dropped.

WITH distinct_systems AS (
    SELECT
        pwsid,
        MIN(pws_name) AS pws_name,
        MIN(size_code) AS size_code,
        MIN(size_category) AS size_category
    FROM {{ ref('stg_ucmr5_results') }}
    GROUP BY pwsid
),

sdwis AS (
    SELECT
        TRIM(pwsid) AS pwsid,
        TRIM(county_served) AS county_served,
        NULLIF(TRIM(city_served), '') AS city_served,
        NULLIF(TRIM(pws_type_code), '') AS pws_type_code
    FROM {{ source('raw_ucmr5', 'sdwis_nc_counties') }}
)

SELECT
    d.pwsid,
    d.pws_name,
    d.size_code,
    d.size_category,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(s.county_served, ''), 'UNMAPPED_COUNTY') AS county_name,
    s.city_served,
    COALESCE(s.pws_type_code, 'UNKNOWN') AS pws_type_code,
    (s.county_served IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(s.county_served) <> '') AS is_county_mapped
FROM distinct_systems d
LEFT JOIN sdwis s
    ON d.pwsid = s.pwsid

model.pfas_warehouse.stg_pfas_benchmarks.name: stg_pfas_benchmarks
model.pfas_warehouse.stg_pfas_benchmarks.description: EPA 2024 NPDWR PFAS MCL and Hazard Index Health-Based Water Concentration (HBWC) screening benchmarks (all six 2024 benchmarks implemented; proposed / not final rescission rulemaking noted in documentation).

contaminant.name: contaminant
contaminant.description: Primary key: EPA UCMR 5 PFAS analyte name.

in_hazard_index.name: in_hazard_index
in_hazard_index.description: TRUE for the four EPA Hazard Index mixture analytes (HFPO-DA, PFNA, PFHxS, PFBS).

model.pfas_warehouse.stg_pfas_benchmarks.raw_code:
-- Staging model: 2024 EPA NPDWR PFAS MCL and Hazard Index HBWC screening benchmarks.
-- Regulatory-status note (proposed / not final): All six 2024 benchmarks are retained
-- for transparent occurrence screening; see README for primary EPA / Federal Register URLs.

SELECT
    TRIM(contaminant) AS contaminant,
    CAST(mcl_benchmark_ppt AS DOUBLE) AS mcl_benchmark_ppt,
    CAST(mcl_benchmark_ug_l AS DOUBLE) AS mcl_benchmark_ug_l,
    CAST(hbwc_ppt AS DOUBLE) AS hbwc_ppt,
    CAST(hbwc_ug_l AS DOUBLE) AS hbwc_ug_l,
    CAST(in_hazard_index AS BOOLEAN) AS in_hazard_index,
    TRIM(benchmark_type) AS benchmark_type,
    TRIM(regulatory_source_url) AS regulatory_source_url
FROM {{ ref('epa_2024_pfas_benchmarks') }}

model.pfas_warehouse.int_system_hazard_i.name: int_system_hazard_index
model.pfas_warehouse.int_system_hazard_i.description: Sampling-event grain computing the 2024 EPA PFAS mixture Hazard Index (HFPO-DA/10 + PFNA/10 + PFHxS/10 + PFBS/2000, in ppt) vs 1.0 screening benchmark.

hazard_index_score.name: hazard_index_score
hazard_index_score.description: Unitless sum of HBWC ratios across the four mixture PFAS analytes.

model.pfas_warehouse.int_system_hazard_i.raw_code:
-- Intermediate model: per-(pwsid, sample_point_id, collection_date) EPA Hazard Index
-- screening score across HFPO-DA (10 ppt), PFNA (10 ppt), PFHxS (10 ppt), and PFBS (2000 ppt).
-- Takes MAX component ratio per analyte within a sampling point + date to avoid
-- double-counting split/duplicate lab aliquots before summing across the 4 mixture analytes.

WITH hi_analytes AS (
    SELECT
        pwsid,
        county_name,
        sample_point_id,
        collection_date,
        collection_year,
        year_quarter,
        contaminant,
        MAX(CASE WHEN is_detected THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS analyte_detected_flag,
        MAX(COALESCE(result_ppt, 0.0)) AS max_analyte_ppt,
        MAX(hbwc_component_ratio) AS analyte_hi_ratio
    FROM {{ ref('int_ucmr5_pfas_screened') }}
    WHERE in_hazard_index = TRUE
    GROUP BY
        pwsid,
        county_name,
        sample_point_id,
        collection_date,
        collection_year,
        year_quarter,
        contaminant
),

aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        pwsid,
        county_name,
        sample_point_id,
        collection_date,
        collection_year,
        year_quarter,
        COUNT(DISTINCT contaminant) AS hi_analytes_sampled,
        SUM(analyte_detected_flag) AS hi_analytes_detected,
        SUM(analyte_hi_ratio) AS hazard_index_score,
        MAX(CASE WHEN contaminant = 'HFPO-DA' THEN analyte_hi_ratio ELSE 0.0 END) AS hfpo_da_hi_component,
        MAX(CASE WHEN contaminant = 'PFNA' THEN analyte_hi_ratio ELSE 0.0 END) AS pfna_hi_component,
        MAX(CASE WHEN contaminant = 'PFHxS' THEN analyte_hi_ratio ELSE 0.0 END) AS pfhxs_hi_component,
        MAX(CASE WHEN contaminant = 'PFBS' THEN analyte_hi_ratio ELSE 0.0 END) AS pfbs_hi_component
    FROM hi_analytes
    GROUP BY
        pwsid,
        county_name,
        sample_point_id,
        collection_date,
        collection_year,
        year_quarter
)

SELECT
    pwsid || '|' || sample_point_id || '|' || CAST(collection_date AS VARCHAR) AS hi_event_key,
    pwsid,
    county_name,
    sample_point_id,
    collection_date,
    collection_year,
    year_quarter,
    hi_analytes_sampled,
    hi_analytes_detected,
    ROUND(hazard_index_score, 6) AS hazard_index_score,
    ROUND(hfpo_da_hi_component, 6) AS hfpo_da_hi_component,
    ROUND(pfna_hi_component, 6) AS pfna_hi_component,
    ROUND(pfhxs_hi_component, 6) AS pfhxs_hi_component,
    ROUND(pfbs_hi_component, 6) AS pfbs_hi_component,
    (hazard_index_score > 1.0) AS above_hi_benchmark_flag
FROM aggregated

model.pfas_warehouse.int_ucmr5_pfas_scre.name: int_ucmr5_pfas_screened
model.pfas_warehouse.int_ucmr5_pfas_scre.description: Analytical-result grain combining NC EPA UCMR 5 results, SDWIS county crosswalk, and 2024 EPA PFAS MCL / HBWC screening benchmarks. Informational screening only.

above_mcl_benchmark_flag.name: above_mcl_benchmark_flag
above_mcl_benchmark_flag.description: TRUE when detected concentration exceeds the 2024 EPA individual MCL screening benchmark.

model.pfas_warehouse.int_ucmr5_pfas_scre.raw_code:
-- Intermediate model: NC UCMR 5 analytical results joined to county crosswalk and
-- 2024 EPA PFAS MCL / HBWC screening benchmarks.
-- Screening-only framing: benchmark flags indicate occurrence vs 2024 EPA screening
-- benchmarks and never regulatory compliance determinations.

WITH results AS (
    SELECT * FROM {{ ref('stg_ucmr5_results') }}
),

crosswalk AS (
    SELECT
        pwsid,
        county_name,
        city_served,
        pws_type_code,
        is_county_mapped
    FROM {{ ref('stg_pws_county_crosswalk') }}
),

benchmarks AS (
    SELECT * FROM {{ ref('stg_pfas_benchmarks') }}
)

SELECT
    r.result_row_id,
    r.pwsid,
    r.pws_name,
    c.county_name,
    c.city_served,
    c.pws_type_code,
    c.is_county_mapped,
    r.size_code,
    r.size_category,
    r.facility_id,
    r.facility_name,
    r.facility_water_type,
    r.sample_point_id,
    r.sample_point_name,
    r.sample_point_type,
    r.collection_date,
    r.collection_year,
    r.collection_quarter,
    r.year_quarter,
    r.sample_id,
    r.contaminant,
    r.analyte_group,
    r.mrl_ug_l,
    r.mrl_ppt,
    r.units,
    r.method_id,
    r.analytical_results_sign,
    r.is_detected,
    r.result_ug_l,
    r.result_ppt,
    r.sample_event_code,
    r.monitoring_requirement,
    r.state_code,
    b.mcl_benchmark_ppt,
    b.mcl_benchmark_ug_l,
    b.hbwc_ppt,
    b.hbwc_ug_l,
    COALESCE(b.in_hazard_index, FALSE) AS in_hazard_index,
    (b.mcl_benchmark_ppt IS NOT NULL) AS has_mcl_benchmark_flag,
    CASE
        WHEN r.is_detected
             AND b.mcl_benchmark_ppt IS NOT NULL
             AND b.mcl_benchmark_ppt > 0
             AND r.result_ppt IS NOT NULL
        THEN r.result_ppt / b.mcl_benchmark_ppt
        ELSE NULL
    END AS benchmark_ratio,
    CASE
        WHEN r.is_detected
             AND b.mcl_benchmark_ppt IS NOT NULL
             AND r.result_ppt IS NOT NULL
             AND r.result_ppt > b.mcl_benchmark_ppt
        THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS above_mcl_benchmark_flag,
    CASE
        WHEN r.is_detected
             AND COALESCE(b.in_hazard_index, FALSE)
             AND b.hbwc_ppt IS NOT NULL
             AND b.hbwc_ppt > 0
             AND r.result_ppt IS NOT NULL
        THEN r.result_ppt / b.hbwc_ppt
        ELSE 0.0
    END AS hbwc_component_ratio
FROM results r
INNER JOIN crosswalk c
    ON r.pwsid = c.pwsid
LEFT JOIN benchmarks b
    ON r.contaminant = b.contaminant

### Welcome!

Welcome to the auto-generated documentation for your dbt project!

### Navigation

You can use the `Project` and `Database` navigation tabs on the left side of the window to explore the models
in your project.

#### Project Tab
The `Project` tab mirrors the directory structure of your dbt project. In this tab, you can see all of the
models defined in your dbt project, as well as models imported from dbt packages.

#### Database Tab
The `Database` tab also exposes your models, but in a format that looks more like a database explorer. This view
shows relations (tables and views) grouped into database schemas. Note that ephemeral models are _not_ shown
in this interface, as they do not exist in the database.

### Graph Exploration
You can click the blue icon on the bottom-right corner of the page to view the lineage graph of your models.

On model pages, you'll see the immediate parents and children of the model you're exploring. By clicking the `Expand`
button at the top-right of this lineage pane, you'll be able to see all of the models that are used to build,
or are built from, the model you're exploring.

Once expanded, you'll be able to use the `--select` and `--exclude` model selection syntax to filter the
models in the graph. For more information on model selection, check out the [dbt docs](https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/model-selection-syntax).

Note that you can also right-click on models to interactively filter and explore the graph.
